Hey, kiddo! You mus' be Bluemoon's kit.
Well, nice to meet ya. I'm Grayclaw.
So, young'un, would ya like to hear a story? (yes/no)
Oh, alrighty, then. Young cats these days... always off doin' somethin', har har..
Right, how 'bout I tell ya about the time I fought off a fox?
That's right, a whole fox, all by myself... I was jus' a young warrior then.
I wus' out huntin' an' I hear this low growlin' behind me.
I turned around an' there it was. This HUGE fox, full-grown by the size of it, was there loomin' in front of me, its fangs glistenin', a hungry look in its eyes.
I was huntin' alone, now, and there didn' seem to be anyone nearby to help. I couldn't run back to camp because I would lead the fox there.
The fox lunged for me... and ya know what I did? I fought right back!
I gave the fox a good ol' swipe across the face with my claws.. that really frightened it.
I remember it backin' up, yelpin', then runnin' at me 'gain, lookin' angrier than before.
I leapt sideways, out of the path of its jaws, but lost my footin' righ' then and there.
I couldn' recover fast 'nough.. I felt its merciless, giant fangs clamp around the base o' my neck.
The ground disappeared beneath me as the fox picked me up an' started to shake me, like a piece of fresh-kill.
I thought I was gonna die for sure.. but, with a new surge o' strength, I managed to reach up and slash my claws across the fox's muzzle.
It dropped me instantly. I found my paws and leaped onto the brute's muscular shoulders, and sunk my teeth and claws into its skin.

The fox, now, had a fit an' started buckin' around- I got thrown off and spun around to attack again, only to see the fox fleein' into the bushes, its tail tucked between its legs, yelpin' like it wanted its mother.
Ha, we never saw that same fox in our territory again! True story.
Now, don't you get any ideas an' go fightin' foxes on your own, though. You might not be as skilled as I was, har har.
I've got another story for ya, young'un. Would ya like to hear it? (yes/no)
Alrighty then. I was alive when Shadestar was just a kit. I've got loads of stories 'bout him.
How 'bout I tell ya the time he sneaked outta camp?
Back then, he was best friends with Oakkit.
Oh, don' know who Oakkit is? He died before ya were born.
Anyway, them two got it in their heads that catchin' some prey for the leader would make them apprentices.
So they went out into the territory to catch mice. 'Course, they couldn't catch anything, har har.
But while they were huntin', they accident'ly walked onto EmberClan territory. Poor things didn' know how merciless those EmberClan cats are.
Fortunat'ly, I was on huntin' patrol and I saw them.
I alerted my patrol and we were gonna rescue them, but it was too late. An EmberClan patrol foun' them.
But before they could take the kits away, we attacked them.
Ha, those EmberClan cats were cowards! They retreated righ' away.
We took them troublesome kits back to camp. The leader punish'd them, 'course. But little did she know, one of them would become leader some day.
'Kay, then. Go do whatever you wish.
You're too ol' for them stories.
Why don' ya go do somethin' else?
